existing_overturn_when: Freeze required universe/history/latency, rights, correction and availability semantics; compare selected providers on representative securities including delistings, ticker reuse and corporate actions, then change the feed/store only when a candidate closes those gaps with auditable records and acceptable measured cost. Add a server or lake only after local throughput/concurrency measurements justify it.
limitations: The authenticated Alpaca receipt covers 25 AAPL SIP/raw daily bars and two corporate actions over five successful pages, not a survivorship-free universe, complete history or real-time feed entitlement.

Numeric corporate-action values matched the frozen probe, but missing dividend currency prevented full cash-unit reconciliation. Original historical availability and complete action coverage remain open.
Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity.
The prior SEC HTTP 403 remains a historical failure. Later corrected acquisition and parsing qualify their selected requests only; no general filing-completeness or strategy-validity claim follows.
SQL, schemas and content hashes cannot repair missing provenance, revised fundamentals, access rights or outcome-selected samples.
requirement: Acquire licensed, source-identifiable US-equity observations; preserve feed, timestamps, identity and corporate actions; produce exact reproducible analytical snapshots and reject data whose historical availability or eligibility is unknown.
requirement_note: The requirement, limitations and existing_overturn_when text is shared by this layer's group; judge fit against the layer title and layer_scope_terms.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
